name: SpacetimeDB
description: The device's one SpacetimeDB server: every PowOS app is a database on it (docs/POWOS-APPS-FEASIBILITY.md section 1). Loopback only; on the phone the port is locked to the PowOS uid (rooted/powos-start.sh).

prepare: [ -s keys/id_ecdsa ] || { openssl ecparam -name prime256v1 -genkey -noout | openssl pkcs8 -topk8 -nocrypt -out keys/id_ecdsa && openssl ec -in keys/id_ecdsa -pubout -out keys/id_ecdsa.pub 2>/dev/null && chmod 600 keys/id_ecdsa; }
